prerequisites.title: 10 active workspaces before submitting
prerequisites.detail: Your app must be installed and tested on 10 or more active workspaces (used in the last 28 days, not sandboxes), or submission is blocked.

prerequisites.title: Production-ready app with test access
prerequisites.detail: Slack needs a feature-complete app, test account credentials with dummy data for your service, and a way to install it, since it cannot use your test workspace login.

prerequisites.title: Video demo and listing assets
prerequisites.detail: A new submission needs a video of install, OAuth flow, setup, end-to-end use and uninstall. Listing needs a privacy policy, public support page and 1600x1000 images.

prerequisites.title: LLM disclosures if the agent uses a model
prerequisites.detail: Disclose the model used, data retention and use, and data tenancy in the Security & Compliance section.

steps.title: Create Slack app and set scopes
steps.detail: Create the app in Slack app settings and add the minimum scopes your agent needs, using a bot token unless acting for a user.
steps.done_when: App exists with client ID and secret.

steps.title: Draft per-scope justifications
steps.detail: Write for each scope how your app uses it, and drop any scope for future features or restricted scopes.
steps.done_when: Every scope has a usage reason.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the auth config via Composio's API with your client ID and secret. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard into Slack's Redirect URLs (HTTPS required).
steps.done_when: Auth config exists and a test connection works.

steps.title: Install on 10 active workspaces
steps.detail: Get customers or test workspaces using the app until 10 active workspaces have tested it.

steps.title: Record demo and prepare listing
steps.detail: Record the install-to-uninstall video, prepare sanitized screenshots, privacy policy, support page and test accounts. Then submit.

steps.title: Wait for Marketplace review
steps.detail: Respond to feedback; each preliminary resubmission resets your queue place.

traps.title: A video of 30-90 seconds is strongly recommended for
traps.detail: A video of 30-90 seconds is strongly recommended for the listing, not strictly required.

traps.title: Unlisted commercial apps are throttled
traps.detail: Commercially distributed non-Marketplace apps get 1 request per minute and 15 objects on conversations.history and conversations.replies. Slack says the Marketplace is the only appropriate channel for commercial distribution.

traps.title: Scope changes break installs
traps.detail: Adding scopes not yet reviewed to a published app's install link shows customers an error. Changes to scopes or redirect URIs need resubmission.

traps.title: History and file scopes get enhanced review
traps.detail: Scopes like *:history, files:read and search:read.* trigger enhanced review and are unlikely to be approved without a clear use case. admin.* scopes are unlikely to be approved for non-partners.

traps.title: Review can be slow and repeats
traps.detail: Slack cannot speed up the review for your launch, and buggy submissions are returned. Fix listing content before submitting.

traps.title: Managed app shows Composio branding
traps.detail: Managed auth shows 'Composio wants to access your account' and shares quota across Composio users.
